title: MIF Container Profile: Corpus Envelope
description: JSON Schema for validating a MIF Container Profile artifact (*.corpus.json): a derived transport serialization of a Bundle, per ADR-021.

@context.description: JSON-LD context. MUST resolve the container vocabulary (container-context.jsonld), not the bare memory-unit context (schema/context.jsonld) -- enforced below for the string/array forms; an inline object form is a bespoke local context and is the producer's own responsibility to get right (schema validation cannot check its term mappings resolve the right vocabulary).

containerProfileVersion.description: Container Profile schema version (independent of mif_version; see ADR-021 Decision point 5)

provenance.description: Corpus-level provenance, following SPECIFICATION.md §12.3's PROV shape exactly (plain keys except @type; wasDerivedFrom etc. take object form)

wasDerivedFrom.description: Reuses mif.schema.json's ProvNode exactly (ADR-021 Decision point 4: corpus-level provenance follows §12.3's PROV shape unchanged, not a narrower reimplementation) -- a plain IRI string, or an open node object keyed by @id or id, or an array of either.

editChain.description: Corpus-transport edit/transfer lineage only. NOT a substitute for a memory record's own Supersedes/SupersededBy relationship (ADR-021 Decision point 6). On disagreement, the per-record relationship wins.

transferId.description: This container transfer's identifier. Deliberately not named `@id` -- these are opaque transport-lineage identifiers, not JSON-LD node identifiers, and must never be subject to relative-IRI resolution on JSON-LD expand (see schema/container-context.jsonld, which maps this term as a plain literal).

supersedes.description: The prior container transfer's identifier this one supersedes. Same opaque-identifier caveat as transferId.

extensions.description: Provider-specific corpus-level extensions, generalizing the per-unit `extensions` field in schema/mif.schema.json to the envelope. Keys are namespaced per implementation (e.g. `mnemos:compressionManifest`, `mnemos:versionDag`). MIF does not validate the contents; that is the owning implementation's responsibility. A concept is promoted out of `extensions` into a native top-level field only once a second, independent implementation needs the identical shape (ADR-021 Decision point 7).

payload.description: For kind:memory, MUST validate against https://mif-spec.dev/schema/mif.schema.json (conceptType required; see ADR-021 Decision point 1). For kind:document, MUST validate against https://mif-spec.dev/schema/mif.schema.json#/$defs/DocumentReference (ADR-014 / ADR-021 Decision point 2) via schema/document-reference.schema.json. This schema does not duplicate either definition; scripts/validate_container.py dispatches on `kind` and validates payload against the correct external schema.
